title: NeoBots
description: This mod adds simple bots to forge.
body:
Welcome to NeoBots, this mods adds simple bots to minecraft, to leave afk on farms or in the world. In future bots will be able to do some actions.


Commands to use the mod:

```
/bot spawn name

/bot despawn name

/bot list 
```

Any problmes or issues will be attended, leave a comment if have any dobuts.

The NeoBots Team
